verdict.rationale: Moosend's own marketing claims automation: it says it puts repetitive tasks on autopilot, sends triggered emails, and builds customer journeys. It also offers event-driven transactional emails. Both are first-party claims of event-triggered actions, but each is a single high-level line with no detail on how users define rules. Missing for 10: documentation of the rule/workflow builder, the supported trigger events, conditions and action types, non-email actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
